sourceNotes: 聚合模式支持点击各指标直接打开详情
修复截图敏感信息识别失败的问题

en: Click individual indicators in combined mode to open their details. Enable Click Indicators to Open Details in menu-bar settings; the context menu still opens Status Overview.

Fix failures when recognizing sensitive text in screenshots. Automatically try fast recognition if accurate recognition is unavailable, and prompt you to review the result and add any missing redactions.
